headline: HuyenBao v11.17 — online AI popup frequency bump + milestone/ambient toast notifications
summary: Quality-of-life pass: the random AI oracle popup now fires more often during online play (~6% per eligible game-day, up from 4%), and a new engine-driven toast queue surfaces milestones + ambient flavor that previously only landed in the life log. The engine now pushes user-facing notifications for: study completion (degree / licence / short course), branch closures, club-network opportunities, significant EVENTS swings (|cash| >= 5000 or fame swing >= 10), power tier promotions, scandals, entity tier promotions, deep-space certification, and a new pool of 20 ambient mini-events ('found $20 on the sidewalk', 'parking ticket', 'a colleague bought your coffee', 'caught a minor cold', etc.) that fire ~3% per game-day with small ± cash/health/spirit swings (capped at ±$500 / ±5 health / ±5 spirit so the economy stays balanced). The ambient events are NOT full AI oracle popups — they're lightweight toast-only flavor lines that make the world feel alive during online play. tick() and applyOffline() both drain the new s.pendingToasts queue into their return value; the React layer surfaces them via the existing showToast() with 1.2s stagger so they don't visually stack. Offline catch-up surfaces up to 3 milestone toasts so players don't miss graduations / scandals / promotions that happened while they were away. No save-state migration beyond the new pendingToasts array (backfilled in migrate()). All four Huyen-Hoc-AI features (Kinh Dịch / Tử Vi / Phong Thuỷ / Tarot) remain unchanged.
features: Random AI oracle popup frequency bumped from ~4% to ~6% per eligible game-day (more online popups)
New pendingToasts queue on GameState + queueToast() helper — engine functions push user-facing notifications; tick() drains the queue into its return value
Study completion toasts: 🎓 Graduated for degrees, 📜 Licence/Short course complete for licences + short courses (previously only in the life log)
Branch closure toast: ⚠️ Business setback — N branches closed this year
Significant EVENTS toast: 🎉/💢 event msg + cash + fame (only when |cash| >= 5000 OR fame swing >= 10 — small swings stay log-only)
Power tier promotion toast: 🏛️ Power tier unlocked: <label>
Scandal toast: 📰 Scandal! Press leaks — scrutiny +10, influence −5
Entity tier promotion toast: 🏢 Entity tier unlocked: <tier>
Deep-space certification toast: 🚀 Deep-space navigation certified — space venture income +20%

New AMBIENT_EVENTS pool: 20 lightweight flavor events that fire ~3% per game-day during online play — 🎉 tin vui (found $20, sold gadget, rebate cheque, won raffle, refund, tip jar overflow), 💢 sự cố (parking ticket, minor cold, lost wallet, bus delayed, Wi-Fi down, subscription renewed, drainpipe leak), 🍵 misc (colleague bought coffee, friend dropped by with food, neighbour returned tool, free samples, stranger complimented outfit). Small ± cash/health/spirit swings capped at ±$500 / ±5 / ±5

UI surfaces res.toasts via showToast() with 1.2s stagger between entries; offline catch-up surfaces up to 3 milestone toasts (capped) so the player sees graduations / scandals / promotions that happened while away
Version label at the FRONT of the app name in the header (v11.17 HuyenBao) — house style continues from v11.15.1
